name: grant committee reviewer
description: how a grant reviewer sees a project: the problem is real, the plan is feasible, the money is accounted for.

criteria.name: a real and stated problem
criteria.description: the problem is concrete and evidenced, not vibes
criteria.strong_answer: a problem statement with cited evidence

criteria.name: feasible plan
criteria.strong_answer: existing work that shows the team can do it

criteria.name: qualified team
criteria.strong_answer: evidence of prior or current related work

criteria.name: clear use of funds
criteria.description: what the money buys is specific
criteria.strong_answer: a budget or a concrete milestone

red_flags: a plan with no evidence of capability
objection_seeds: what happens when the grant ends
why is a grant needed instead of revenue
